blockers.finding: Entry004/wrapper004 cannot import arbitrary direct-call outputs. Smallest successor is request-driven external-result ingestion with explicit verified external provenance, preserving natural wave planning and latest-pass acceptance/F6 checks.

Seven simultaneous route-A stages are disallowed in both examined routes: campaign has process budget17 and peak8 per call, direct guard014 allows max_active<=6 plus previous-first-iteration ramp. Seven total calls may overlap after one exits route A on the direct route. Do not transfer the campaign total-call bound to the direct launcher.

engine_invariance.answer: Deterministic exact-response reuse preserves requested engine decisions by induction. Thirty actual Jacobian branch AST comparisons passed for early nominal cache versus on-demand inert responses, including invalid seed, plus/minus invalidity, halving and budgets. Unrequested minus results stay out of evaluation log; global duplicate exclusion reads that log, not persistent cache. Bulk preloading changes probe misses and operational wave numbering; lazy import after genuine natural planning is required to preserve wave custody. Full engine/custody integration remains UNTESTED.

earliest_start.spec_dependency: h11 assembler L275 onward writes exactly these fields. Parent Mapper builds from base(template plus numerics), theta, fixed coordinates and label; core adds certificate slots from registry; ledger mapper adds certified slots for non-genesis points. None of the five H11 fields is inserted into the call spec. Holding template/numerics/certificate pins/label recipe and theta fixed therefore preserves all seven raw specs before and after these five field updates. This does NOT cover other H3 updates to numerics or tail_readiness certificates.
earliest_start.earliest_conditional: At the adopted verdict, once each exact final call spec, certificate/prelaunch policy and direct admission are valid, calls can in principle be computed without waiting for these five evidence fields. Do not launch pending-cert draft bytes: certified slots change SHA. Existing production ledger_append requires initialized workdir and passing gates; pre-certification by itself is not pre-H11 production-ledger admission. Root needs a reviewed direct certificate lookup for these non-genesis points and a later importer.
earliest_start.volumes: A direct receipt and acceptance bind the original call/result locations. External1 can be the proposed early output volume only under root-reviewed direct admission and capacity checks; leave those directories in place. Current campaign reingest accepts no external call-dir argument and requires work_dir/waves/wave_N/campaign/call_I. Thus no existing compliant early External1-to-new-drive reuse path exists. A successor should retain original external custody and import by reference after natural wave planning, not copy/move and pretend the call ran in a wave directory. New-drive availability need not delay computation in that future design, but it still delays normal campaign initialization.

hedge.calls: Nominal seed+plus+minus =7. Two halving levels across3axes produce6 extra plus candidates; all halving sides produce12 extra. The12global points bring all conditional extras to24 and total campaign candidates31. With H11, respective totals18,24,30,42.
hedge.cpu_workers: Configured route-A workers: base7=56; six extra halved-plus=48; all24extras=192; H11+all31=336 workers. Worker count is not measured simultaneous CPU demand.
hedge.disk_caveat: b* is the prior capacity threshold, not a bound. At80GiB output cap,31calls can consume2480GiB before reserve,42calls3360GiB. R(b) must include early unused outputs; no deletion assumed.
hedge.gain: If a nominal plus fails, having its valid half-plus result ready can remove that one forward wait; the corresponding half-minus is still needed and may require another wait unless also hedged. If half-plus fails again, quarter-plus is useful; never assume a valid seed, a valid minus, or a reached global_design. If all nominal plus/minus are valid, these extras save no engine latency and consume resources. Expected gain cannot be numeric without branch probabilities and stage/service-time measurements. Computation alone must not add evaluation-log rows or F6 judgments.

cpu_estimate.basis: Dispatch0820 reports A247 H11 about24h with11overlapping calls. Accepted as coordinator-reported measurement; raw runs were not opened. This replaces the older11.7h model as the stated overlap basis.
cpu_estimate.assumptions: All calls have equal remaining CPU work; fixed aggregate throughput; already CPU-saturated; perfectly fair sharing; no memory/I/O nonlinearities. These assumptions are deliberately explicit and unverified.
cpu_estimate.18_calls: 18/11=1.636: H11 completion and comparable early calls about39.27h, about15.27h later H11. This is not a prediction; adding workers cannot create CPU capacity.
cpu_estimate.ordering: No unique fastest order is provable from one H11 makespan and no branch probabilities. Under the equal-work saturated model, H11 then all7 costs24+7*24/11=39.27h, the same total as fair simultaneous18; concurrent launch does not itself improve that lower bound and delays gate readiness. With variable stages/spare resources, overlap may improve it. A conditional starting order is H11 first (required evidence), then seed and nominal Jacobian calls as soon as the reviewed early path exists; place branch-dependent halves/global last. This is an information-priority order, not a cap or scheduling throttle. A claim that it minimizes real u_A time needs stage-aware simulation and validity probabilities; label that UNTESTED.
cpu_estimate.principal_priority: More total processing is acceptable under A258; that does not imply every speculative job reduces makespan. Preserve quality and exact engine decisions while comparing strategies.
